title: CmdPal: Fix run command icon flicker and switch to shell icon provider

proposed_comments.title: Guard relative path normalization for icons

confidence.rationale: The pinned lazy icon path reaches Path.GetFullPath from raw timeout-fallback input, and a long relative path throws PathTooLongException.

proposed_comments.body:
### Keep malformed relative queries from breaking icon binding

**Severity:** `medium`

The lazy `Icon` getter calls `ResolveIconPath`, whose relative-path branch passes directly to `Path.GetFullPath`. The timeout fallback can construct a `RunExeItem` from the original query, so an overlong relative query can throw `PathTooLongException` when its icon is evaluated instead of falling back to the generic icon. Please catch the expected path-normalization exceptions at this call and return `null` so the existing `Icons.RunGeneric` fallback is used.
